title: How Salon Automation Adds Value to Your Beauty Business

facts.fact: The Meevo blog post 'How Salon Automation Adds Value to Your Beauty Business' was published on 2025-10-21.
Meevo's example describes an automated reminder system that texts a client 24 hours before their appointment so they can confirm or reschedule (an illustrative example, not a measured result).
facts.quote: For instance, your system can automatically text a client 24 hours before their appointment, giving them a chance to confirm or reschedule

facts.fact: Meevo's example of an automated birthday campaign sends a 'Happy Birthday' message with a 10% off coupon (illustrative example, not a benchmark).
facts.quote: your system can automatically send a “Happy Birthday” message with a 10% off coupon

facts.fact: Meevo's example loyalty program offers a free deep conditioning treatment after every five visits or a 10% discount on every tenth visit (illustrative example).
facts.quote: offer a free deep conditioning treatment after every five visits or a 10% discount on every tenth visit.
